body.text: Crypto News Bot — Daily Digest
August 11, 2026
Stablecoin supply keeps climbing toward $1T by year-end: USDT nears $189B after another $1B mint, while USDC targets $150B in H2 2026.
Stablecoin News
Tether mints another $1B USDT
Tether pushed total USDT supply to roughly $189 billion with a fresh 1B mint on Aug 10, an on-chain event now routine for the market leader.
Circle wins NY trust charter, eyes $150B USDC
Circle's New York Trust entity received a limited-purpose trust charter from NYDFS on Jul 31, adding custody powers as it targets $150B USDC supply in H2 2026.
USDC growing faster than USDT
USDC supply is up 73% year-over-year versus USDT's 36%, though USDT and USDC together still hold 93% of the roughly $308B stablecoin market.
GENIUS Act rulemaking grinds on
A year after passage, OCC and FDIC are still drafting implementing rules; OCC issued a new proposed rulemaking on stablecoin issuance and FDIC has 144 open questions for issuers.
Hacking & Security Incidents
Coinsbuy exchange loses $7.9M in cross-chain drain
Hot wallets on Ethereum and TRON were drained almost simultaneously on Aug 9; attacker laundered ~79% of funds via FixedFloat into Monero before Coinsbuy refilled balances within 24 hours.
Coldcard firmware flaw drains $116M in Bitcoin
A five-year-old firmware bug in Coinkite's Coldcard hardware wallet let an attacker steal 1,816 BTC from 5,200 addresses since Jul 30 — now the third-largest crypto hack of 2026.
Two bridges hacked in one day, $31.5M lost
AFX Trade and Verus cross-chain bridges were hit within hours of each other on Jul 22-23; AFX lost $24.15M to compromised validator keys, Verus lost $7.54M to a reused exploit.
2026 already the worst year on record for hacks
With 164 separate incidents logged through early August, 2026 has surpassed every prior full year, pushing cumulative 2026 losses past $1.2B.
